item.title: Injuu Kunoichi ~Chuugi o Koeru Reizoku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tsurumiku -Another-
  • 発売日: 2024-01-26
  • スコア: 6.13/10 (14 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 淫従くノ一 ～忠義を超える隷属～
  • 英語名: Injuu Kunoichi Chuugi o Koeru Reizoku

あらすじ

In the Edo period───.

A daimyo and the governor of Nagasa District “Shibata Samon”, joins forces with “Daikokuya Rihei” in committing evil deeds, spending their days with their pockets filled.

But one day, they hear the news that a spy may have been sent to investigate them. Is the spy an official, or perhaps from someone who is jealous of Samon’s wealth and trying to bring him down.

item.title: Hitokari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tsurumiku -Another-
  • 発売日: 2023-10-27
  • スコア: 6.0/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 非道狩り ～ヒトカリ～
  • 英語名: Hitokari

あらすじ

The story is set in modern-day Japan, where the protagonist, operating through social media, takes on the unconventional role of a HitoKari - someone who punishes individuals displaying audacious and disrespectful behavior. While perceived as a god by those seeking justice, he manipulates the system by targeting individuals less likely to face consequences. This time, he receives requests to deal with a haughty idol and a corrupt lawyer. Of course that requires a proper strategy – choosing the right location, method, and deriving the appropriate pleasure.

item.description:

  • 日本語名: 侵・性奴会～美人会長と爆乳書記の調教日報～
  • 英語名: Shin Seidokai Bijin Kaichou to Bakunyuu Shoki no Choukyou Nippou

あらすじ

Ryuuguuin Reia’s carelessness causes the protagonist Kuzunoi Takatora, to be injured to the point that he has to stay in a hospital.

Although the student council president makes an apology, Takatora demands that atonement must be made with not words but attitudes. Nodding her head, Reia promises that she and her secretary will take responsibility.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tsurumiku -Another-
  • 発売日: 2021-09-24
  • スコア: 6.75/10 (49 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 童貞の俺が女上司と出張に行ったら、部屋が同じだった件
  • 英語名: Doutei no Ore ga Onna Joushi to Shucchou ni Ittara, Heya ga Onaji Datta Ken

あらすじ

A shortage of workers due to the declining birthrate and aging society….

Tamachi Electronics, a major foreign-affiliated medical equipment manufacturer, is no exception, and is looking for motivated employees. The protagonist, Toshiaki Murakami, is one of them.

He is not a highly skilled employee, but he is willing to face anything head on and hit the ground running until he gets results. He was assigned to the Marketing Department, which continues to be the top sales department in Japan.

item.title: Yami Yuuenchi de Kakurenbo ~Matabiraki no Yoru~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tsurumiku -Another-
  • 発売日: 2021-01-29
  • スコア: 6.33/10 (17 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 闇遊園地でかくれんぼ～マタビラキの夜～
  • 英語名: Yami Yuuenchi de Kakurenbo Matabiraki no Yoru

あらすじ

A regional amusement park, [Tsurumiku Attraction Park]—commonly known as [Tsurupa]—has fallen on hard times due to the emergence of powerful competitors and now faces the threat of closure.

Although it is barely managing to stay open, due to rural depopulation and a declining birthrate coupled with an aging population, the staff is small and consists almost entirely of seniors, leading to frequent sudden, unscheduled closures.

item.title: Saimin Gyakushuu ~Douzo Watashi-tachi o Suki ni Shite Kudasai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tsurumiku -Another-
  • 発売日: 2020-01-31
  • スコア: 6.58/10 (83 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 催眠逆襲～どうぞ私たちを好きにしてください～
  • 英語名: Saimin Gyakushuu Douzo Watashi-tachi o Suki ni Shite Kudasai

あらすじ

One day, Gomi Kuzuhito, whom everyone else detests for his gloomy personality and appearance, gets hold of a smartphone game with hypnotic powers. He possesses a mysterious power that allows him to manipulate others at will, and he decides to use it to take revenge on those who have mocked him. Several women come to mind. —An extremely strict English teacher. —His daughter, a classmate of the protagonist. —An art teacher whose superficial kindness is irritating. —His daughter, a swim club member a year younger than him. Even the student council president, the school principal, and the board president. The targets are so diverse that it’s difficult to choose. And so begins the counterattack through hypnosis… the hypnotic counterattack.
